game.name: Piano Tiles 2
game.rules:
**New rule as of 11/27/2020:**
All runs will now require video proof. All current runs will not be affected.

'Times' are actually high-scores. The format is 1ms per point, so a score of 1,179 would be submitted as 1s and 179ms, therefore 'slower times' are higher on the leaderboard.

If you're a runner who is in the region of 14+tps, this is usually several repeats after three crowns, we may begin to ask for a **handcam** with your footage. This is informal at the moment and is very unlikely to result in runs being rejected but it still comes down to the moderator's discretion. Otherwise, do not worry about having only a screen-recording.
